info.name: Midtrans Payment Card Tokenization Core API API

items.docs: Performs a charge for the chosen `payment_type`. Supported types include credit_card, bank_transfer (Permata / BCA / BNI / BRI virtual account), echannel (Mandiri Bill), gopay, shopeepay, qris, cstore (Indomaret / Alfamart), akulaku, and more. The response carries a `transaction_status` plus method-specific payment instructions (VA number, QR string, deeplink, or redirect URL).
